record.question: State whether the following statements are True or False: (a) Leave not due may be granted or production of Medical Certificate. (b) Paternity Leave is up to a period of fifteen days. (c) A Government Servant on Extraordinary leave is entitled to Leave Salary. (d) The maximum number of Earned Leave which can be encashed to a government Servant is 300 days. (e) A female Government Servant with less than three surviving children can be granted maternity leave.
record.explanation: The choices are all placeholders and do not encode a True/False response, so no option index is defensible. The statements are: (a) True—leave not due can be granted on a medical certificate; (b) True—paternity leave is up to 15 days; (c) False—extraordinary leave carries no leave salary; (d) True—the earned-leave encashment ceiling is 300 days; (e) False—maternity leave applies to a female Government servant with fewer than two surviving children, not fewer than three.
